P_calibration.quote: A court might aggregate runs on a substance-over-form theory, so this reading carries real risk.

P_holdback.quote: the team should decide which to raise publicly as workability objections and which to analyze privately.

P_grandfather_step.quote: The grandfather date (enactment) creates an incentive to start large runs before enactment. This "race to start" effect is a strong policy argument

P_reliance_caveat.quote: Courts and prosecutors look through form to substance, and secondary liability is available. Treat these as litigation risk, not operating plans.
